question.prompt: Given \(\angle AOB=70^\circ\), \(\angle BOC=30^\circ\), and \(O, A, B, C\) lie in the same plane, what is the measure of \(\angle AOC\) in degrees? (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas, in any order.)

solutions.explanation: Ray \(OC\) may lie outside \(\angle AOB\), giving \(\angle AOC=70^\circ+30^\circ=100^\circ\), or inside \(\angle AOB\), giving \(\angle AOC=70^\circ-30^\circ=40^\circ\). Both cases are possible.
solutions.title: Consider both ray positions
